newsitem.title: UK: European raw cotton enquiry remains routine.
newsitem.headline: European raw cotton enquiry remains routine.

text.p: In the absence of a significant price change, enquiry for raw cotton in most European importing markets remianed routine, trade sources said.
Much of the enquiry that was seen, was directed towards central Asian types.

Mill buyers in Germany and Belgium have concentrated their attention on additional lots for nearby shipment. Portugal however, has seen some interest shown in shipment supplies as far ahead as the turn of the year.
Some business has also been noted in the Benin 1997/1998 crop for shipment during the first quarter of 1998.
